sourceFile: 24. BRS-161016 Report tracking test VP damage 15.03.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft captures the table values but misstates the changed factor as a baseline/test comparison instead of sequential VP process tracking.
issues: Process checkpoints are incorrectly split between changed conditions and subgroup keys.
Outcome metric should be VP damage or NG rate, not the section title.
Conclusion row showing no VP damage is omitted.
Header row for metric columns is omitted.
correctionPlan: Reframe changed factor as VP process checkpoint tracking from Material VP through Sub 1 and Main 2.
Use Material VP as initial checkpoint, not an implicit normal baseline.
Keep Sub 1 and Main 2 as process group context for their rows.
Rename outcome metric to VP damage count and NG rate by checkpoint.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Existing row citations support numeric results, but header and conclusion citations are needed before final use.
